_comment: One category per semester. Subjects and exam channels both live inside it,
so Semester 6 becomes a second category and Semester 5 stays intact as an archive.
'syllabus' is posted and pinned inside the subject's own channel by !learn setup.
Write it however you like. Re-running setup edits the existing pinned message
'key' must stay stable once messages are captured against it.

subjects.name: Computer Networks
subjects.syllabus:
**COMPUTER NETWORKS** (BE05000171)

__MSE-1 covers Units 1, 2, 3 — 40%__

**Unit 1 — Introduction to Computer Networks**
Network models, OSI model, TCP/IP model, network topologies, transmission media, switching techniques, LAN technologies, IPv4 addressing, IPv6 addressing

**Unit 2 — Data Link and Network Layer**
Error detection and correction, framing, MAC protocols, routing algorithms, RIP, OSPF, switching concepts, BGP, subnetting, CIDR, VLANs

**Unit 3 — Transport and Application Layer**
TCP, UDP, congestion control, flow control, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, email protocols

*Not in MSE-1: wireless/IoT/cloud, network security, SDN*

subjects.name: Data Mining Techniques
subjects.syllabus:
**DATA MINING TECHNIQUES** (BE05000181)

__MSE-1 covers Units 1, 3, 4 — 40%__
⚠️ Unit 2 (preprocessing) is NOT in MSE-1

**Unit 1 — Introduction**
Data mining, KDD process, data mining functionalities, applications, task primitives, major issues. Statistical measures: central tendency (mean, median, mode), dispersion (range, variance, standard deviation), data distribution concepts

**Unit 3 — Frequent Patterns & Associations**
Market basket analysis, frequent itemsets, closed itemsets, association rules, frequent itemset mining methods, mining various kinds of association rules

**Unit 4 — Classification and Prediction**
Classification vs prediction, issues, statistical-based algorithms, distance-based algorithms, decision tree induction, Bayes classification, rule-based classification, model evaluation and selection, techniques to improve accuracy

subjects.name: Machine Learning
subjects.syllabus:
**MACHINE LEARNING** (BE05000211)

__MSE-1 covers Units 1, 2, 5 — 40%__
⚠️ Units 3 and 4 are NOT in MSE-1

**Unit 1 — Introduction**
What is learning, machine learning, comparison with traditional programming, AI vs ML vs DL, ML lifecycle, types of ML (supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement), types of problems (regression, classification, clustering), dataset: training/testing, underfitting, overfitting, bias-variance tradeoff

**Unit 2 — Supervised Learning: Regression**
Simple linear regression, multiple linear regression, gradient descent algorithm, polynomial regression, cost function

**Unit 5 — Unsupervised Learning**
Clustering algorithms, partitioning methods (k-means and k-medoids)

*Not in MSE-1: logistic regression, SVM, KNN, PCA, ensembles, neural networks*

subjects.name: Occupational Health & Safety Management
subjects.syllabus:
**OCCUPATIONAL HEALTH & SAFETY MANAGEMENT** (BE05000451)

__MSE-1 covers Units 1, 2, 3, 4 — 40%__

**Unit 1 — Occupational Health**
Classification of occupational health hazards, routes of entry of toxic material into the body, dangerous properties of chemicals and their health effects, hierarchy of hazard control (elimination, substitution, engineering control, administrative control, PPE), work environmental sampling and types, permissible exposure limits, threshold limit value, lethal dose and lethal concentration, ergonomics and its constituents

**Unit 2 — Concept, Philosophy & Psychology of Safety**
Concept of safety, nature of the concept, philosophy of safety, safety terminology, total safety concept, safety psychology, accident causative factors, general psychological factors, salient points of the Factories Act 1948

**Unit 3 — Accident Causes and Prevention**
Causation, accident problem, reasons for prevention, factors impending safety, accident prevention

**Unit 4 — Electrical Safety**
Electricity and hazards, Indian standards, effects of electrical parameters on the human body, safety measures for electric works

subjects.name: Python for Data Science
subjects.syllabus:
**PYTHON FOR DATA SCIENCE** (BE05000231)

__MSE-1 covers Units 1, 2, 3, 4 — 40%__

**Unit 1 — Introduction, Data Types & Operators**
Features and history of Python, variables and data types, operators (arithmetic, assignment, comparison, logical, membership, identity, bitwise), list, tuple, set, dictionary, string operations.
Decision making, loops and functions: if/elif/else, boolean expressions, while, for, nested loops, break, continue, pass, custom functions

**Unit 2 — File & Exception Handling**
File I/O, text files, CSV files, binary files, exception handling, Python MySQL basics

**Unit 3 — Data Science and Descriptive Statistics**
Understanding data and its types, data science life cycle, data analysis (univariate, bivariate, multivariate), data measurement scale, descriptive statistics (central tendency, dispersion, location, shape and symmetry)

**Unit 4 — Exploring Python Libraries**
SciPy stats package, NumPy multidimensional arrays

subjects.name: Web Application Development
subjects.syllabus:
**WEB APPLICATION DEVELOPMENT** (BE05000281)

__MSE-1 covers Units 1, 2, 3, 4 — 40%__

**Unit 1 — Introduction to Web Technologies**
Web technologies, evolution of websites, client-server architecture, frontend/backend/database overview, static vs dynamic websites

**Unit 2 — HTML & CSS Fundamentals**
HTML structure, basic tags, tables, forms, media elements, div and semantic elements, CSS selectors and styling, colors, backgrounds, fonts, margin, padding, borders, flexbox layout, positioning, responsive design basics

**Unit 3 — JavaScript Fundamentals**
Variables and datatypes, operators and conditions, loops and functions, arrays and objects, DOM manipulation

**Unit 4 — APIs & HTTP Communication**
Introduction to APIs, client-server communication, HTTP request and response, status codes, query parameters, request body, CRUD operations, JSON and XML, integrating public APIs

*Not in MSE-1: Node.js, React.js, deployment*
